decisions.reason: The accelerator program builds little on the firm's recycling-machinery and manufacturing knowledge, so it cannot easily interpret or improve early results.
The bio-based bitumen binder is a material product outside the firm's core plastic and used-oil recycling machinery expertise, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve it.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is adjacent to existing waste-treatment machinery and the Biofabrik/ERMAFA cooperation provides related knowledge to learn and improve.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant directly builds on the firm's modular recycling and manufacturing know-how, making early results interpretable and improvement likely.
